run_docgen_default: run docgen.py to build gRPC Python documentation using the default opt configuration
run_docgen_custom_config: run docgen.py with a custom build configuration via the --config flag
run_docgen_submit: run docgen.py with --submit to generate and push Python docs to a GitHub repository
run_docgen_repo_owner: run docgen.py with --repo-owner and --doc-branch to push docs to a specific branch
review_docgen_script: review the docgen.py script to understand the virtualenv setup and Sphinx documentation build pipeline
